project_type: .NET 8 WPF worship-presenter desktop app (WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln). Projects: WorshipPlayer.Core (net8.0, cross-platform models/services), WorshipPlayer.Audio (net8.0-windows, NAudio/WASAPI mixer), WorshipPlayer.Presenter (net8.0-windows WPF, EnableWindowsTargeting), WorshipPlayer.UI (net8.0-windows WPF main app), WorshipPlayer.Tests (net8.0 xUnit).
build_system: dotnet / MSBuild via WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln. Host is Windows so WPF projects build. Quirk: WorshipPlayer.Tests is net8.0 and CANNOT reference the net8.0-windows Presenter project; it references WorshipPlayer.Core and links selected Presenter source files via <Compile Include ... Link=...>. Any new type the tests need must either live in WorshipPlayer.Core or be a Presenter source already linked (PresenterEngine.cs, StageDisplayData.cs, ThemeManager.cs, MusicianViewRenderer.cs, RemoteCommandHandler.cs, VideoLibrary.cs, NdiOutputService.cs, StubNdiOutput.cs, TemplateService.cs, AlertService.cs, CountdownService.cs). StageDisplayServer.cs/StageDisplayHtml.cs/RemoteHtml.cs and the ASP.NET Core hosting stack are NOT linked and MUST NOT be added (would add warnings/deps).
test_framework: xUnit 2.6.6 (Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.8.0). Tests use temp folders (Path.GetTempPath + Guid) and write JSON inline with File.WriteAllText; no test-content-file copying is set up. Follow that style.
verification_instructions: After each feature run its listed verification commands. HARD INVARIANT for the whole task: `dotnet build WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln --nologo` = 0 errors and EXACTLY the 4 pre-existing warnings (NO new warnings); `dotnet test WorshipPlayer.Tests --nologo` = all green (411 baseline + any new tests). For Core-only changes you may build/test just the affected project to iterate, but the final verification MUST use the full solution build + full test run. Do NOT run the full suite if your instructions tell you not to; otherwise run it. Grep is not verification.
environment_constraints: Windows host. All work in the worktree .worktrees\presenter-offline-hardening on branch feature/presenter-offline-hardening; use `git -C <worktree>` for git. Do NOT touch the main checkout and do NOT create a new worktree. Audio stems named in Songs/Open The Heavens/song.json and Songs/TheBlessing/_song_registry.json are ABSENT from this worktree's Songs folder (they exist in the main checkout) so end-to-end audio and real second-monitor/LAN/LibVLC checks are human-on-hardware, not CI.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING present. Match existing code style and the Tests project's <Compile Include> linking convention. Commit locally on the branch; never push. Place StageServerPortProbe and StageServerStartResult in WorshipPlayer.Core (design Fix F8 Decision 4).
key_patterns: Core models have non-null-defaulted collections (Song.Tracks/Sections = new(); Slide.Content = new()) but hand-edited JSON can still produce nulls — guard on the consumption path. ChordProParserService.Transpose(text,semitones): +N transposes chords UP (C idx0 +2 => D), returns text unchanged at 0. PresenterEngine.GetStageText(slide, transposeSemitones) already delegates to Transpose and short-circuits at 0 — REUSE it (do NOT invent a new method). ServiceOrderManager.LoadAsync already catches/returns null; ServiceOrderLoaded fires on load. Audio render thread raises MultiTrackMixer.SectionChanged/PositionChanged; AudioEngine re-raises; PresenterIntegration.BroadcastStageUpdate reads TEN engine members on that thread (torn-read risk -> F12). StageDisplayServer production uses the single-arg ctor new StageDisplayServer(port) leaving _presenterSettings/_remoteCommandHandler/_presenterEngine null.
